title: This startup making the electricity grid more resilient while reducing wildfires just raised $10.5 million.
summary: Business Insider sits down with Gridware CEO, Tim Barat to talk about its technology, its seed extension funding and its impact.
body_markdown:
Business Insider sits down with Gridware CEO, Tim Barat to talk about how its real-time grid monitoring technology is working to prevent forest fires and make the grid more resilient.


‍


The article reviews Gridware’s recent $10.5 million seed extension funding round lead by Lowercarbon Capital and Fifty Years with JP Morgan adding debt funding.


‍


Also shared is an exclusive look at the 10-slide pitch deck Gridware used to raise the seed extension.


‍


Read the full article here:[https://www.businessinsider.com/gridware-10-million-lowercarbon-fifty-years-electricity-wildfires-pitch-deck-2023-6](https://www.businessinsider.com/gridware-10-million-lowercarbon-fifty-years-electricity-wildfires-pitch-deck-2023-6)
